messages:
harper: Flagging an inconsistency in the ListModels pagination docs. The REST examples use `?cursor=abc123` but the JS SDK examples show `pageToken: 'abc123'`. OpenAPI currently documents `cursor`. Which one should be canonical? Customers are getting confused when porting examples.

jess: Good catch. Runtime accepts either `cursor` or `page_token` as query params (legacy), and SDKs historically exposed `pageToken`. We should pick a single public name to avoid churn. Recommendation: standardize on `page_token` (snake_case) in the HTTP API and map SDKs to camelCase `pageToken` to match language conventions.

owen: Tech note: OpenAPI currently uses `cursor` which is a shorter legacy name; changing that to `page_token` is a breaking schema change for some generated clients. Devex: we should update docs first, then submit an OpenAPI PR that adds `page_token` and marks `cursor` as deprecated in the schema description for one release. That lets codegens pick it up safely.

harper: Plan: update the API ref examples (curl/python/ts) to use `page_token` everywhere, include a tiny migration note (`cursor` -> `page_token` mapping), and add example responses showing `next_page_token`. Also include a short note: "SDKs map this to `pageToken` in idiomatic clients."

devex: Devex approves approach. We'll coordinate client regen after OpenAPI change. Also suggest adding a docs snippet showing how to handle either param during transition: `const token = params.pageToken || params.cursor || params.page_token;`.

harper: I'll open a PR with updated examples and a migration paragraph. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/11002 (preview included).

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR 11002 created -> https://deploy-preview-11002--docs.redwood.ai. Preview shows examples using `page_token` and `next_page_token`.

jess: Left a comment asking for side-by-side code: (1) raw curl query param `?page_token=...`, (2) Python requests `params={'page_token': token}`, (3) JS SDK `listModels({ pageToken: token })`. Also request to clarify that `next_page_token` is returned as empty string when no more pages.

owen: Added a note to the PR to include an OpenAPI diff in the description and mark `cursor` as deprecated. That will make the schema change review easier.

harper: Updated PR per feedback, added the transitional code snippet and the OpenAPI change proposal. Tests in preview pass.

devex: LGTM. We'll schedule the OpenAPI change for the next minor sync so we can regen SDKs. Please add a release-note bullet: "API ref: pagination param canonicalized to page_token (SDKs expose pageToken)".

jess: Merged. I'll post a short note in #support with copy-and-paste examples for customers. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
